# LINK-1U (V2, accepted 2026-10-24): link J1 -> J2 of the user, lightened - plate 10, base 12, gussets 6, windows
# 10 / 20 from the edges, fillets R8 in the inner corners (base / gussets, base / plate). 30ХГСА, 5.50 kg.
# Generated by tools/gen_link1u.py 10 12 6 20 <file> 10 8 from the user's geometry (STEP J1-J2.STEP, IGES J1-J2.IGS).
# Coordinates: THE FRAME OF THE USER'S PART, mm. In the user's assembly:
#   part X = the J1 axis (upward), the J1 axis runs through y=0 z=-85 of the part;
#   part Z = the J2 axis (horizontal), through x=0 y=0 - the two axes cross at (0, 0, -85).
#   BASE on J1 (x -135..-123): rectangle y +-112 + round R120 round the J1 axis, bore D115 (spigot of the adapter
#     "Юла"), 12 x M8 on D139 (every 30 deg from +Y), 5 x D14 on D217 (30 / 150 / 210 / 270 / 330 deg);
#   J2 PLATE (z 0..10): y +-112, bore D190 on the output-side pilot D190h7 of the DMRD-80E (its flange D222 on z=0),
#     16 x D9 on D206 every 22.5 deg from +X;
#   2 gussets 6 (y +-112..118) with windows R10; 10 x 45 chamfers on the outer top edges.
# FEA (fea/link1u/summary.md): max rotation 0.61 mrad (~1.6 mm at the TCP), vM away from the edges <= 115 MPa,
#   peaks 183..256 MPa at the gusset ends / fillet tangents (mesh 4 mm) - n >= 3.3 vs 835.
# The macro has no FILLET op: the fillets are filler prisms (square R x R minus a circle R).
ASSEMBLY LINK-1U

CUT X -136 -122.0 RECT 112 125 -210 12.0
CUT X -136 -122.0 RECT -125 -112 -210 12.0
CUT X -136 -122.0 RECT -125 125 10.0 40
PRISM Y 112 118.0 POLY -135 -127 -105 -127 70 -12 70 10.0 -135 10.0
PRISM Y -118.0 -112 POLY -135 -127 -105 -127 70 -12 70 10.0 -135 10.0
CUT Y -123 123 POLY -136 -1.0 -124 11.0 -136 11.0
CUT X -136 71 POLY 119.0 -1.0 119.0 11.0 107.0 11.0
CUT X -136 71 POLY -119.0 -1.0 -107.0 11.0 -119.0 11.0
CUT Y 111 119.0 RPOLY -113.0 -10.0 10 36.625 -10.0 10 -113.0 -108.325 10
CUT Y -119.0 -111 RPOLY -113.0 -10.0 10 36.625 -10.0 10 -113.0 -108.325 10

CUT X -136 -122.0 CIRC 93.963 -30.75 14

CUT X -136 -122.0 CIRC -93.963 -139.25 14
CUT X -136 -122.0 CIRC 0 -193.5 14
# ---- fillets R8 in the inner corners (filler = square R x R minus a circle R)
PRISM Z -127 0 RECT -123.0 -115.0 104.0 112   # base / gusset +Y, along Z
CUT Z -127 0 CIRC -115.0 104.0 16.0
PRISM Z -127 0 RECT -123.0 -115.0 -112 -104.0   # base / gusset -Y
CUT Z -127 0 CIRC -115.0 -104.0 16.0
PRISM Y -112 112 RECT -123.0 -115.0 -8.0 0   # base / plate, along Y
CUT Y -112 112 CIRC -115.0 -8.0 16.0
PORTP j1_out X -135 -1 role=on_j1_adapter bore=115 holes=12xM8_D139+5xD14_D217
PORTP j2_base Z 0 -1 role=j2_80E_flange bore=190 holes=16xD9_D206
